C0057.title: Yangpu District Shopping Mall Parking Fee Fraud via Points Arbitrage
C0057.summary: Between 2020 and 2021, Yang and Xia exploited malicious software to virtually register new users on Shopping Mall A's official app, accumulating points to offset parking fees. Approximately 120 vehicles were involved, each linked to thousands of phone numbers, profiting from the platform's marketing campaign through fake accounts.
